Change 1636 MERGED as f808e82385 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, submitted by RebarBotNava). Gerrit rebased server-side, so the landed sha differs from the locally-committed 1d7fc26859; the worktree was realigned onto f808e82385 and the ACs re-verified against the LANDED tree, not the local one.

Verification on the landed tree: 11 held-out tests pass; every touched file under the 800-LOC cap (step_failures.py 101, runner.py 796, gate_dispatch.py 721, workflow_ops.py 564, _llm_commands.py 764); the schema declares coverage.llm_step_failures with required [total, by_step]. Pre-merge full gates: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS (503 files), unit 7417 passed / 14 skipped, interfaces 1769 passed / 12 skipped.

All 9 ACs checked off. Note for future readers: this ticket arrived with no comments and no AC set — the "AC4 split" refers to the PARENT bug b273 description recording that its original fourth criterion became this ticket. The AC set here was authored fresh and taken through the plan-review gate (BLOCK then PASS).

Follow-up for the deliberately out-of-scope gates: beryl-orange-oropendola (fba8-5271-add6-4603), linked discovered_from.
